mail.subject: RE: BUS225 Assessment 2 – Group 9 – Draft for Feedback
summary: Earlier draft needed substantial revision: physical journey, actual store observations, current Self Checkout/Scan&Go/Tally, broader robotics trends and global Carrefour examples.
Recommendations must explain customer journey effects. Blueprint should follow class format and clearly separate visible/hidden actions and connect support to customer steps.
Lecturer recommended less reliance on generated content, original research and first-hand observation. This feedback concerns the earlier draft, not the new November 4 blueprint.
